description: A ward bishopric’s working tool — meeting programs, assignments, interviews and a members roster.

notes.29: Welcome the newly baptized and those who moved in; releases now come before sustainings.
notes.30: Welcome block first in ward business, with the note beside each name.
notes.31: Every bishopric responsibility on the member's card, not three of five: reminders and responsibilities have their own blocks, the presiding officer gets one, and callings appear at any status rather than only once called.
notes.32: Responsibilities can be assigned to any ward calling, not only the bishopric's three. Assigning to a calling is what gives its holder a card of their own.
notes.33: The callings catalogue carries the assignment names itself, so the separate list of positions is gone — a position is a row in Lookup, beside the organization and calling it belongs to.
notes.34: A position is now named by its own organization and calling, so nothing has to be typed for it and a calling you add in Lookup can be linked to an account straight away. UPDATING AN EXISTING DATABASE: do this in order. (1) BEFORE updating, in Lists, rename bishop to bishopric_bishop, counselor1 to bishopric_first_counselor and counselor2 to bishopric_second_counselor — renaming rewrites every row that uses them. (2) Update. (3) In Lookup, add the organization bishopric with the callings bishop, first_counselor and second_counselor. (4) In Lookup, link each position to its account again; the links were keyed to the old list and do not move. Rows and account links are never overwritten by an update, so nothing is lost if you stop partway.
